findings.title: Handle the http.Get error before accessing resp.
findings.rationale:
Line 10 discards the request error. If http.Get fails, resp is nil. Line 11 then panics when it evaluates resp.Body.

Proposed fix

func Fetch(url string) (int, error) { -	resp, _ := http.Get(url) +	resp, err := http.Get(url) +	if err != nil { +		return 0, err +	} defer resp.Body.Close()

-	body, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body) +	body, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
